messages:
Sam (partnerships): Heads up — Borealis Energy just signed an ISV listing on Azure Marketplace and a 12-month Dedicated + Private deployment contract. Big win for energy/OT use cases. :tada: Marketplace listing: https://azuremarketplace.microsoft.com/items/borealis-redwood-inference
Maria (solutions): Amazing news! Any high level commit numbers we can share publicly?
Sam (partnerships): Committed ~$360k ARR. Start date: June 1. Architecture: Private control plane + on-prem agents for sensor ingestion, Dedicated GPU pool for forecasting models and heavy batch jobs. Their internal perf run showed ~3x latency improvement vs their old endpoint.
Alex (sales): Great — I can push a short case study. Can someone paste the onboarding notes / runbook? @Taylor?
Taylor (CS): Put together an onboarding runbook earlier today, gist here: https://gist.github.com/redwood/borealis-onboarding
Taylor (CS): Quick excerpt:
```
1) Provision Private control plane in customer VNet
2) Deploy edge agents with config: {
  "model_pin": "forecast-v2",
  "kv_cache": true,
  "batching": "latency-optimized"
}
3) Reserve Dedicated pool (4x A100 equiv) for forecasting window
```
Jamal (eng): We routed them to the r5-dedicated-pool and pre-warmed the KV cache during the perf tests. Ops note: schedule capacity reservation for June 1 and add their nat rules to the allowlist.
Maria (solutions): I'll add this to the wins doc and draft an internal announcement. Can we get a 1-2 sentence quote from the Borealis PM for the case study? Alex can you own outreach?
Alex (sales): Yep, I'll ask for a quote and booth it to marketing. ETA EOD Friday.
capacity-bot: Reserved 4 nodes in eu-north-1 for customer BOREALIS-2026-06 (reservation id: R-784512).
Sam (partnerships): Huge thanks to integrations, cs, and infra for a smooth close. :raised_hands: If anyone has standout metrics (cost delta, p50/p95 latency) drop them here so the case study has numbers.
Taylor (CS): I'll share the perf dashboard snapshot tomorrow morning.
Jamal (eng): We'll run a follow-up load test next week and post results.
Maria (solutions): Internal comms plan: short blurb in #all-hands, partner spotlight in newsletter, and a one-pager for field. Will @Sam review before send?
Sam (partnerships): Yep — will review. Congrats team! :confetti_ball:
